crossRefs.note: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired another portion, and the tower of the furnaces.
Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah…
After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib…

people.name: Meremoth
people.line: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

people.name: Rehum
people.line: One of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel
